quote: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: If possible, drive in a lane that is not adjacent to the lane in which the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency is moving, unless roadway, traffic, weather or other conditions make doing so unsafe or impossible. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation.condition: A qualifying authorized emergency or regulatory official vehicle is moving or visibly preparing to move with qualifying flashing lights as another driver approaches.

obligation.description: If possible, drive in a lane not adjacent to the lane in which the source vehicle moves, unless roadway, traffic, weather or other conditions make that unsafe or impossible.

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: Original officer direction may change the required response.

timing.description: Review the source-defined approach and response interval; 30 seconds is a recording requirement, not a statutory deadline.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency
judgment_calls_needed.note: Blueprint identity alone does not prove authorization or regulatory agency status.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: moving or preparing to move in any direction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original motion or a hand signal visible to the approaching driver is required; 0.05 m/s is only a sensor convention.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original equipment qualification and full-frame pixel review are distinct sources.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: If possible, drive in a lane that is not adjacent
judgment_calls_needed.note: Lane topology, traffic, roadway, weather and other conditions inform possibility and safety; no numeric legal cutoff is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_calls_needed.note: Officer identity, direction content, recipient, visibility and time require original review.
